notes.title: Changes to difficulty modes.
notes.notes:
Normal difficulty mode now has 3 lives instead of one.
There are now 3 difficulty modes:
- Normal: 3 lives / level.
- Hard: 1 life / level.
- Hardest: 1 life / level, and various changes (some levels are longer and includes more and larger obstacles).
Small UI-fixes.
Small in-game fixes.

notes.title: Difficulty modes added.
notes.notes:
Difficulty modes added.
Current mode is called Hard Mode, and a new easier mode is called Normal Mode.
The game will start with normal mode selected.
The difficulty modes can be changed here: Main Menu -> Extra -> Difficulty
